summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication date of its Q2 2026 results on 28 July 2026, along with a schedule of future dividend dates. This is a routine corporate calendar update with no transactional event, no acquisition or divestiture terms, no strategic review, and no activist involvement. The filing serves only as a notice to shareholders regarding earnings timing and dividend record/ex-dividend dates. It is a regulatory communication typical of a foreign private issuer and does not qualify as a special situation.
